about: Known answers for the review eval set. Each answer comes from the harness-benchmark grader (code, scores.jsonl) and, where it names the mechanism, a postmortem log entry. Survivability-pilot findings are added as answers once the pilot has reproduced them (review-01: the pilot's HIGH and MEDIUM items for P1 core-6, 2026-10-25 02:25). Case names are neutral (review-NN, a fixed shuffle) so that a reviewer's paths do not name the run, the arm or the profile. Every configuration reviews the same head per case (the stored final tree), so flagged-and-fixed counts from the original runs are not a metric here. The set has no one-shot trees; one-shot trees rebuilt from transcript replays must be labelled as such when added.
